## gitshift

🎭 Manage GitHub and GitLab identities with SSH

### Synopsis

gitshift manages local Git identities for GitHub and GitLab accounts.

Supported Platforms:
- GitHub (github.com and GitHub Enterprise)
- GitLab (gitlab.com and self-hosted)

Features:
- 🔐 SSH-first account configuration
- 🔄 Git, SSH, GPG, and GitHub CLI switching
- 📁 Opt-in directory-based switching for zsh
- 🔑 SSH key discovery from ~/.ssh directory
- 📧 Identity discovery from SSH and GPG metadata
- 🌐 Public and self-hosted GitHub/GitLab domains

```
gitshift [flags]
```

### Options

```
      --config string   config file (default is $HOME/.config/gitshift/config.yaml)
  -h, --help            help for gitshift
  -v, --version         Print version information
```
